title: A World Model of Radiologist Reading for Medical Image Representation Learning
domain: Chest radiography; radiologist visual-search representation learning
dataset_or_cohort: MIMIC-EYE/MIMIC-CXR for pretraining; GazeSearch ChestSearch; CheXpert; RSNA Pneumonia; SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax
sample_scale: MIMIC-EYE: 3,032 frontal CXRs; GazeSearch: 3,870 train and 488 test images; external diagnosis datasets: CheXpert 224,316 images, RSNA 26,684, SIIM-ACR 12,047
institution_count: MIMIC-EYE derives from one hospital; external datasets add distinct sources, exact aggregate institution count NI
split_strategy: Official MIMIC-EYE split 2,729/151/152; GazeSearch 3,870/488; downstream benchmark splits and fixed-seed label fractions
observation_process: Static frontal CXR paired with temporally ordered 60-Hz gaze and dwell time; fixations mapped to image patches and repeated visits merged
missingness: NA
censoring_or_competing_events: NA
state: Image-patch latents plus the prefix of gaze-ordered visited patches with spatial, temporal, and dwell embeddings
observation_decoder: Predicts the next fixated-patch latent and spatially completes unvisited patches; frozen representations feed diagnosis and seven-fixation scanpath heads
action: Radiologist fixation sequence/order; no clinical treatment or robot-control action
action_provenance: Observed expert gaze behavior
transition_mechanism: JEPA-style causal Transformer predicts next-fixation latent against an EMA target encoder; cross-attention performs spatial completion
maximum_horizon: One fixation step during pretraining; downstream scanpath decoder emits seven fixations
rollout_regime: Teacher-forced observed gaze prefixes during pretraining; downstream inference starts from the image and does not freely simulate clinical state
capability_claim: Passive behavioral forecasting and representation learning, not intervention simulation
baselines: BioViL, MedKLIP, MGCA, GLoRIA, PRIOR, MedCLIP, CheXWorld, EGMA; GazeFormer, HAT, GazeSearch, LogitGaze variants
state_fidelity_metrics: Diagnosis AUROC, accuracy, and F1; scanpath ScanMatch, SED, STDE, and MultiMatch; no direct latent-state fidelity metric
transition_metrics: Next-fixation/scanpath metrics and downstream transfer; no clinical transition outcome metric
rollout_stability: NI; no free-running long-horizon rollout
action_sensitivity: Chronological versus raster/random order; autoregressive-only and spatial-completion-only ablations
calibration_and_uncertainty: NI; no calibration or predictive-uncertainty evaluation
external_validation: Transfer evaluated on CheXpert, RSNA, SIIM-ACR, and GazeSearch, but not in prospective clinical deployment
decision_utility: Frozen-feature diagnosis and scanpath probing only; no decision-impact study
safety_evaluation: NA
statistical_analysis: Fixed-seed label fractions; no confidence intervals or repeated-run variance reported
causal_language: Uses causal attention/order terminology only; no causal treatment-effect claim
estimand: Prediction of expert gaze and image labels under the observed data distribution
counterfactual_validation: NA
data_access: MIMIC data require credentialed access; other benchmark access varies by dataset
preprocessing_reproducibility: Detailed gaze-to-patch conversion, architecture, training, and downstream protocols
randomness: Fixed seed reported for label-fraction sampling; multi-seed model evaluation NI
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec. 3 and Fig. 1 pp.3-5; Sec. 4 and Tables 1-5 pp.5-9; Limitations p.10; Appendices A-B pp.13-15
appraisal_strengths: Controlled objective and ordering ablations; several external image benchmarks; explicit visual-search metrics
appraisal_limitations: One gaze corpus and chest-radiography setting; no free-running dynamics, calibration, or statistical uncertainty; some baseline backbones differ

title: Action-Conditioned World Model for Goal Plane Probe Guidance in Robotic Ultrasound
dataset_or_cohort: Self-collected neck ultrasound cohort covering carotid and thyroid goal-plane guidance plus random sweeps
sample_scale: 20 participants; 184 carotid trajectories with 196358 frames; 150 thyroid trajectories with 518161 frames; 17 random-sweep trajectories with 135353 frames
institution_count: NI (institution count not explicitly reported)
split_strategy: Patient-level split: carotid 147 train/37 test; thyroid 120/30; random sweeps 13/4
observation_process: Sequential ultrasound frames synchronized with 6-DoF probe poses; variable-length trajectories
missingness: NI (no missing-data procedure reported)
censoring_or_competing_events: NA (procedural trajectories; no clinical time-to-event endpoint)
state: VAE latent state from recent ultrasound context frames; goal-plane bank represented as latent distributions
observation_decoder: Predicted future ultrasound frame; policy also emits motion-axis class, magnitude bin, and stop decision
action: Relative 6-DoF probe motion; deployed controller uses x, y, rx, and ry commands while z and rz are handled by lower-level force control
action_provenance: Observed synchronized pose differences for world-model training; policy-generated discrete corrective robot commands at deployment
transition_mechanism: Conditional latent-diffusion Transformer predicts a future latent from context, action, and temporal offset
maximum_horizon: Future-image evaluation from 0.5 to 30 s; closed-loop guidance episodes up to 100 s
rollout_regime: Offset-conditioned future prediction and forward-inverse cycles; policy uses one-step model rollouts during training and fresh observations in physical closed loop, not long chained video generation
capability_claim: closed-loop planning for action-conditioned robotic probe guidance
baselines: Supervised policy with and without goal conditioning; zero-action control; no alternative world-model architecture baseline
state_fidelity_metrics: LPIPS and SSIM for generated ultrasound frames; goal-plane recognition accuracy
transition_metrics: LPIPS/SSIM by temporal offset; forward-inverse reconstruction; motion-axis and magnitude-bin accuracy
rollout_stability: Horizon-stratified LPIPS/SSIM and forward-inverse cycle tests; no physical-state constraint or cumulative free-running drift metric
action_sensitivity: Inverse-action versus zero-action control; goal-conditioning and reinforcement-learning ablations
calibration_and_uncertainty: Diffusion is stochastic and plots show standard-deviation bands, but no calibration, coverage, repeated-rollout uncertainty audit, or uncertainty-aware fallback
external_validation: Real robot experiments are reported, but on the same system and study setting; no external institution, device, or population validation
decision_utility: 20 physical trials per task; goal-plane success was 70% for carotid and 65% for thyroid, with steps and completion time reported
safety_evaluation: Force controller and restricted command axes are described; no force outcomes, adverse-event taxonomy, override test, or monitoring analysis
statistical_analysis: Means and standard-deviation bands are reported; no confidence intervals or significance testing located
causal_language: Uses action-dynamics and guidance language and explicitly limits the model to visual dynamics in the observed data distribution rather than a physical simulator
estimand: Observed-policy action-conditioned future-image prediction and closed-loop task performance
confounding_strategy: None reported for observational probe motions
positivity_and_overlap: Not evaluated; action support is limited to recorded motions and the deployed command set
counterfactual_validation: No causal counterfactual validation; zero-action and inverse-cycle tests assess model response only
data_access: private/self-collected; access mechanism NI
preprocessing_reproducibility: partial: acquisition, pose synchronization, resizing, latent model, and splits are described, but complete data-processing artifacts are unavailable
randomness: Seeds and number of independent training runs NI
evidence_anchors: Sec. II, pp. 2-4: cohort, latent diffusion world model, actions, and policy; Table I, p. 5: trajectory/frame counts and patient split; Fig. 4 and Tables II-IV, pp. 5-7: horizon fidelity, controls, and robot results; Discussion, p. 8: evidence boundary and limitations
appraisal_strengths: Patient-level separation, multi-horizon image evaluation, an action control, and physical closed-loop testing directly address the embodied guidance claim
appraisal_limitations: Only 20 participants in one reported setting; no competing world-model baseline, action shuffling, calibrated uncertainty, external validation, or measured force safety outcome; the visual model omits contact mechanics
source_status: Primary arXiv v2 full text inspected; open access

title: Affective Music Recommendation: A Rollout-Based World Model for Offline Preference Optimization
domain: Affective music recommendation and digital therapeutics
dataset_or_cohort: Proprietary LUCID clinical and consumer-wellness interaction logs
sample_scale: 939 users; 8,784 sessions; 57,822 interactions; 5,992 unique songs played from a 6,988-song catalog; 16,927 positive and 2,561 negative ratings
institution_count: Single platform; clinical site count NI
split_strategy: Ten random Monte Carlo splits, 80/10/10 by user ID; users disjoint and splits shared across models
observation_process: Irregular song-level engagement and optional ratings plus session-level pre/post valence-arousal under a fixed production policy
missingness: Ratings and post-session affect are optional; losses mask unobserved positions; no imputation reported
censoring_or_competing_events: Session endings observed; dropout or informative censoring NI
state: Listening history containing songs, feedback and session boundaries
observation_decoder: Predicts engagement, rating, valence and arousal feedback
action: Next-song recommendation
action_provenance: Historical songs selected by the deployed production policy; imagined songs selected by evaluated policies
transition_mechanism: Factorized causal decoder-only transformer; predicted feedback is appended autoregressively
maximum_horizon: Five recommended songs
rollout_regime: Free-running song-feedback rollout initialized from logged histories
capability_claim: Closed-loop offline preference optimization and predeployment simulation; real-user causal efficacy is not demonstrated
baselines: Architecture and embedding ablations; Random, Greedy and Copycat policies; no independent simulator
state_fidelity_metrics: Continuous feedback MSE and R2; rating AUC
transition_metrics: Rollout-level predicted feedback only; no horizon-stratified transition error
rollout_stability: Coverage, normalized entropy, intra-list diversity, Gini and policy alignment across rollouts
action_sensitivity: Recommended-song-input removal plus Random, Greedy, Copycat and DPO policy comparisons; no action shuffling or dose response
calibration_and_uncertainty: NI; no predictive intervals, coverage or calibration analysis
external_validation: None; one proprietary platform and logged policy
decision_utility: Simulator-predicted DPO valence-arousal and diversity gains; no online patient or user outcomes
safety_evaluation: Fully offline evaluation, Copycat and KL anchoring, diversity and alignment monitoring, and synthetic or perturbed-history stress tests; no deployment hazard protocol
statistical_analysis: Ten split mean and SD with paired t-tests; policy evaluation uses five shared random seeds
causal_language: Uses counterfactual-history and in-silico-simulator language without causal identification
estimand: Model-predicted feedback and utility under dynamics learned from the logged production policy; not an intervention effect
confounding_strategy: Exposure bias is acknowledged and behavior-cloning or KL regularization is used; no measured-confounder adjustment
positivity_and_overlap: NI; action support or overlap is not evaluated
counterfactual_validation: NI; perturbed histories are stress tests rather than ground-truth counterfactuals
data_access: Private proprietary logs; no public data access
preprocessing_reproducibility: Partial; embeddings, sequence construction, masked losses and split procedure are described, but the full production preprocessing pipeline is unavailable
randomness: Ten random user splits and five shared policy seeds; exact seed values NI
evidence_anchors: p.1 Abstract; pp.2-4 Sec. 3 and Fig. 1 for data, state, action and model; pp.5-8 Sec. 4 and Tables 1-5 for splits, metrics, ablations and policy rollouts; p.8 Sec. 5.1-5.3 for safety scope and limitations
appraisal_strengths: User-disjoint cold-start evaluation, repeated splits and seeds, missing-aware objectives, and several rollout diversity or stability measures
appraisal_limitations: Optimization and evaluation use the same learned simulator; single platform and policy; no calibration, external validation, online outcomes or causal identification

title: Agentifying Patient Dynamics within LLMs through Interacting with Clinical World Model
dataset_or_cohort: MIMIC-IV v2.2 Sepsis-3 cohort; external MIMIC-III
sample_scale: 20,092 ICU stays; 725 sampled held-out episodes for LLM/OPE evaluation; 2,862 MIMIC-III OOD episodes
institution_count: 1 source health system; MIMIC-III is an earlier cohort from the same center
split_strategy: Patient/stay-level 70/20/10 train/validation/test; external cross-dataset MIMIC-III evaluation
observation_process: 42 demographic, physiologic, laboratory, respiratory, and treatment-history variables aggregated every 4 h from 24 h before to 48 h after sepsis onset
missingness: Forward fill; if no prior value, training-set population median; explicit missingness masks enter the GRU
censoring_or_competing_events: Excludes age <18, ICU stays <24 h, and missing mortality; terminal survival/death used in reward; discharge/death handling beyond this is NI
state: History-aware latent state from 42 variables, static features, missingness masks, and prior actions
observation_decoder: Gaussian next-state mean/variance plus ventilation, SOFA/SIRS consistency, and 90-day mortality heads
action: Joint 5x5 discrete IV-fluid and vasopressor dose grid
action_provenance: Observed clinician actions for retrospective training/OPE; LLM-proposed candidate actions in simulation
transition_mechanism: Two-layer GRU with action embedding and diagonal-Gaussian next-state head
maximum_horizon: 4-h next-state transition; 12-step/48-h outcome window and model-based policy rollouts
rollout_regime: Next-state model evaluated mainly one step; agent performs multi-step closed-loop rollouts inside the learned simulator; no horizon-stratified free-running fidelity
capability_claim: Counterfactual treatment comparison and closed-loop treatment planning
baselines: Clinician policy; DDQN, AI Clinician, WD3QNE; multiple vanilla LLMs; same LLMs with world-model access; Qwen3-4B backbone
state_fidelity_metrics: Next-state MAE; ventilation AUC; mortality AUROC/AUPRC; IHM and 24-h vasopressor-requirement AUROC/AUPRC
transition_metrics: State MAE 0.316 for selected GRU; outcome AUROC 0.804 and AUPRC 0.663
rollout_stability: NI; no drift, divergence, or constraint-violation curve by rollout horizon
action_sensitivity: World-model-access and clinical-prior ablations; no action removal, shuffle, dose, or support perturbation test
calibration_and_uncertainty: Gaussian likelihood used, but predictive calibration/coverage and abstention are NI
external_validation: Retrospective OPE on 2,862 MIMIC-III episodes
decision_utility: DR, WIS, and WPDIS policy-value estimates; guideline adherence and unsafe-action rates; no prospective clinician-use study
safety_evaluation: Guideline adherence; extreme under/overdosing rules; 241-episode failure analysis manually checked by four emergency-medicine reviewers
statistical_analysis: Point estimates and ablations; confidence intervals, significance tests, and repeated-seed analysis NI
causal_language: Calls simulated alternatives counterfactual treatment responses and treatment-policy optimization
estimand: Retrospective value of a learned dynamic treatment policy under OPE; not an identified individual treatment effect
confounding_strategy: No explicit causal confounding design; relies on retrospective behavior-policy OPE and learned simulator
counterfactual_validation: Retrospective OPE, guideline rules, and expert failure review; no randomized or quasi-experimental validation
data_access: Credentialed public MIMIC-IV/MIMIC-III
preprocessing_reproducibility: Detailed cohort criteria, 4-h aggregation, variables, imputation, action mapping, and hyperparameters
randomness: Random 725-episode test sample reported; model/training seeds and repeated runs NI
evidence_anchors: pp.1-5 Abstract, Secs.2-3, Tables 1-2; pp.8-9 Sec.5, Tables 3-4; pp.15-18 Apps.C-F, Tables 5-10; pp.23-24 Apps.I-J, Table 11, Figs.7-8
appraisal_strengths: Detailed state/action construction, strong policy baselines, external retrospective cohort, explicit safety metrics and expert-checked failures
appraisal_limitations: High-capability planning claim rests on a learned simulator and OPE; no action-support analysis, causal identification, calibrated uncertainty, prospective validation, or free-running physiology audit

title: Arti-JEPA: Adapting Video World Model to Real-Time MRI of the Vocal Tract for Speech-Production Analysis

missingness: NA
censoring_or_competing_events: NA
state: Spatiotemporal V-JEPA2 latent representation of a vocal-tract rtMRI clip

baselines: Adapted and stock VideoMAE; stock V-JEPA2; DINOv2; ImageNet ViT; frozen-probe comparisons
state_fidelity_metrics: Cohen kappa, phoneme error rate, macro-F1, balanced accuracy; representation standard deviation, effective rank, and cosine-similarity collapse diagnostics

safety_evaluation: NA

causal_language: No causal-effect language; world-model terminology refers to learned video structure

title: BLINK: Behavioral Latent Modeling of NK Cell Cytotoxicity
dataset_or_cohort: Approximately 10-hour NK-cell and PC3/PSMA tumor-cell co-culture microscopy recording
sample_scale: 571 tracked trajectories and about 250000 trajectory frames; 485 train, 29 validation, and 57 test trajectories
institution_count: NI (one experimental recording is described; institution count not reported)
split_strategy: Random trajectory-level 85/5/10 split within the same recording
observation_process: Brightfield, tumor-nucleus, NK-cell, and caspase/viability channels sampled every 60 s; NK-centered 128x128 tracked crops
missingness: Tracking failures or gaps are not described; partial observability is discussed conceptually but not analyzed as missingness
censoring_or_competing_events: Tracks shorter than 60 frames are excluded; handling of tracks ending through death, exit, or loss to follow-up is NI
state: DreamerV2-style recurrent state-space model with deterministic h and stochastic z latent state
observation_decoder: Reconstructed microscopy observations and nonnegative apoptosis increments accumulated into predicted cell-death progression
action: Two-dimensional NK-cell inter-frame displacement
action_provenance: Observed biological cell motion derived from tracked trajectories; not an assigned intervention
transition_mechanism: Action-conditioned recurrent stochastic latent transition with prior and posterior networks
maximum_horizon: Training windows of 50 frames; 30-step free latent forecast metric; observed trajectories extend to approximately 600 frames
rollout_regime: Sequential reconstruction/prediction over observed tracks plus a 30-step free latent rollout; no enacted closed-loop intervention
capability_claim: action-conditioned passive forecasting of cellular behavior and cytotoxicity
baselines: Zero, mean, FrameAE, GRU-regress, GRU-monotone, and BLINK without action
state_fidelity_metrics: Apoptosis MAE, RMSE, Pearson correlation, and proportion within plus or minus 1; latent UMAP, clustering, and state-transition summaries
transition_metrics: Thirty-frame forecast MAE; trajectory-level apoptosis prediction and latent behavioral transitions
rollout_stability: Monotone nonnegative apoptosis increments constrain one output; no drift, physical-coherence, or stability analysis beyond the 30-step forecast
action_sensitivity: BLINK without action ablation
calibration_and_uncertainty: Stochastic latent state is used, but no predictive calibration, interval coverage, horizon uncertainty, subgroup analysis, or abstention mechanism is reported
external_validation: None; all splits arise from the same co-culture recording
decision_utility: Assay-level death-progression prediction and exploratory behavioral-mode discovery; no clinical or experimental decision study
safety_evaluation: NA for clinical deployment; no biological-intervention safety evaluation
statistical_analysis: Point estimates and mean-plus/minus values are reported, but the source does not establish confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, or the resampling unit
causal_language: No causal or counterfactual claim; action denotes observed NK motion
estimand: Observed-trajectory prediction under measured cell motion
confounding_strategy: None reported; motion is observed rather than randomized
counterfactual_validation: None
data_access: private/self-collected; access route NI
preprocessing_reproducibility: partial: imaging channels, tracking, crop size, interval, exclusion, architecture, and split are described; full pipeline and data are unavailable
randomness: Seeds and number of independent runs NI
evidence_anchors: Methods, pp. 3-5: RSSM state, action, decoder, and monotonic outcome; Dataset and protocol, p. 6: recording, tracking, scale, split, and exclusions; Table 1, p. 7: predictive baselines and metrics; Fig. 3, p. 8: latent modes and transitions
appraisal_strengths: Long single-cell trajectories, an explicit monotonic outcome constraint, a no-action ablation, and a free-forecast metric support action-conditioned cellular forecasting
appraisal_limitations: One recording creates dependence and possible leakage across trajectory splits; track termination is not modeled; no external data, calibration, action perturbation, statistical testing, or intervention evidence
source_status: Primary arXiv v2 full text inspected; open access

positivity_and_overlap: NI; treatment overlap is not assessed

appraisal_strengths: Subject-level splitting, two independent external cohorts, strong task-specific baselines and explicitly treatment-conditioned images

title: ChronoMedicalWorld: A Medical World Model for Learning Patient Trajectories from Longitudinal Care Data
domain: Longitudinal chronic kidney disease EHR forecasting
dataset_or_cohort: Private KidneyOnline longitudinal-care cohort, 1999-2026
sample_scale: 2,232 patients; 15,070 patient-years; dynamic rollout points 4,875 train, 1,020 validation, 1,078 test
institution_count: One clinical platform/source
split_strategy: Patient-level split: 1,562 train, 334 validation, 336 test
observation_process: Irregular clinical follow-up aggregated by calendar year; annual clinical variables, drug exposure, and patient-clinician messages
missingness: Explicit missingness: urine protein 28.2%, blood pressure 40.0%, no communication 33.3%; missingness flags and measurement counts; zero vector for no communication
